question: How much of M-release EOG span-sign identifiability survives one entire geographic site's systematically wrong A/B/M assessment? Distinguish unique sites from repeated readings.

observation.D: exact current G or G minus one true occupied node (only false negative); D otherwise complete and all negatives trusted
observation.candidate: World G must include all D and have at most one additional true positive

response.target: sign of original EOG 90% positive pairwise environmental span after ideal M release Gcf=A&B
response.metric: unchanged fixed landscape median/MAD reference, per-world exact current G full-census span, parent sign tolerance

assay.observation_unit: one independent GEOGRAPHIC grid node where all three binary A/B/M states are read as a single three-bit profile
assay.cost: one per DISTINCT geographic node; exactly 3 axis-bit readings at selected node, equal site costs
assay.error: at most one chosen node's entire three-bit profile may be arbitrary/wrong; all repeated readings at that same geographic node share this potential error and cannot count as new independent site
assay.robust_requirement: for every pair of distinct compatible BAM masks having different EOG target signs, the selected profiles differ at >=3 DISTINCT geographic nodes; zero-error baseline requires >=1
assay.optimization: SciPy MILP binary x_site in {0,1}, minimize sum x_site subject to each target-discordant pair's distinguishing site count >=1 or >=3; exact optimal only; no heuristic substitution
assay.infeasibility: if any target-discordant pair differs at fewer than3 grid nodes even with entire landscape observed, report IMPOSSIBLE under model (null), do not invent added sites
assay.independent_audit: explicitly enumerate every candidate truth and every possible single-site corrupted three-bit profile, and check no alternate target sign remains compatible
assay.secondary: site-independent individual read error result is comparator only; retain its distinct cost interpretation

denominators.report: all 2627 D observation fibres and nested original 129 true-G classes
denominators.worst_case_true_G: For each true G, all D it can generate must be uniformly identified at given budget; impossible D blocks robustness for that G
denominators.pair_weight: Deduplicate identical A/B/M triples. Never use number of parameter labels as independent weights.
denominators.no_inference: No population frequencies, p-values or confidence intervals from the finite worlds

integrity: previous one-read-error histograms unchanged and only comparator
every chosen site unique and within declared grid; each observation comprises A,B,M
every discordant target pair differing at >=3 selected sites for robust result
independent all-corruption-pattern decoder always contains truth and never contains opposite sign
infeasible defined exclusively by fewer than3 distinguishing sites for at least one target-discordant pair
no positive progress claimed in infeasible classes
robust budget counts nondecreasing and never exceed zero-error
no user private or additional field data
limits: One geographically shared systematic site error may corrupt all A/B/M measurements at that location, not all errors in a spatial region
Any number of repeat readings at one faulty site remains faulty; no correction through same-site replication
Assumes complete three-axis ground-truth profile at each chosen site and calibrated bounded one-site error; unrealistic in nature
Nonadaptive exact site-set optimum, not adaptive decision-tree or field survey minimum
At most one missed occupied cell outside perfect current distribution; not general effort-adjusted detection
Only original exposed artificial candidate worlds, ideal static mask release, no causal mechanism or new EOG-WF endpoint
